svg.text: I’m a master’s student at the Graduate School of Pharmaceutical Sciences,

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

svg.text: The University of Tokyo, and a member of the Mizuno Group. My research sits

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

svg.text: at the intersection of biomedical NLP, literature mining, and knowledge

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

svg.text: discovery — teaching machines to read the scientific literature so

text.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, serif

svg.text: researchers don’t have to read all of it themselves.
